info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tetrahed Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tetrahed Drill Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information related to tetrahed drills within the catalog. This API allows consumers to efficiently add new drill specifications, enhancing the overall product offering. Typical users include inventory managers and sales teams seeking to maintain up-to-date and accurate drill data. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their operations and improve customer access to detailed product information.

post.summary: Create details for a Tetrahed Drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a Tetrahed Drill, ensuring all relevant specifications and settings are captured effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the tetrahed drill operation. It contains all necessary information required to process the operation effectively.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the details have been returned.

CreateCatalogTetrahedDrillDetailRequest.title: Tetrahed Drill Operation Request Body

tetrahed_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Tetrahed Drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The number of units requested for the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the operation is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Tetrahed Drill.

tags.description: A list of tags that can be used to categorize the operation.

items.description: Tags associated with the operation for categorization.

CreateCatalogTetrahedDrillDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the structure of the request body for creating a Tetrahed Drill operation. It includes details about the drill ID, request initiator, quantity requested, priority status, unit price, and associated tags.

CreateCatalogTetrahedDrillDetailResponse.title: Tetrahed Drill Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record processed during the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

warnings.description: A list of warnings generated during the operation, if any.

items.description: A warning message related to the operation.

CreateCatalogTetrahedDrillDetailResponse.description: Response schema for the successful operation of the Tetrahed Drill API, containing status and processing details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
